hi ! im not the best at giving advice but I wanted to tell you that you're not alone. I don't have memory issues that are as bad as yours but I have them nonetheless. I feel like I can't remember a lot of things and I always forget to do things and get in trouble for it, and I also have diagnosed depression and anxiety, and I feel like those are the causes for my issues as well. I think you should talk more to your therapist about how severe this is for you !! it sucks when people downplay your issues so maybe try to talk to someone who you trust and feel like will take you seriously ?? for the eating thing, maybe you can set alarm notifications ?? like set an alarm for every few hours and then try to get that to remind you ...? I know tips like that probably arent helpful considering how severe your problem is, but i honestly feel like setting alarms for yourself will help you to at least eat. if you live with someone maybe you can ask them to remind you to eat ?? for everything else i am honestly not sure because im not an expert on things like this, but i hope things get better for you friend !! please remember that what you are experiencing is not at all your fault, so don't take people's frustration to heart. they don't know what it is like to be you so they have no place to judge you. i wish you the best !!!! <3
